accordion.$description: Expandable disclosure rows. Built 2026-09-07 for the Explore Degrees results — its entire Degree Requirements tab is these: one row per requirement, showing a status icon, a name, a 'Covered / Still to do' label and a chevron, expanding to the classes that count toward it. Native-first like every other disclosure in this system: a real `<details>`/`<summary>` pair, so open/close, keyboard operation and find-in-page all work with no JS at all — the same reasoning behind Tooltip being pure CSS and Popover/Modal using the native APIs. **Rows, not boxes:** an accordion here is a flush list divided by hairlines, and the consumer wraps it in a Card if it needs an edge. That is deliberate — the reference stacks bordered boxes and it reads as a pile; a divided list of the same content reads as a list. What sits before and after the title lives in two optional slots (see `slot`): the done / todo / error mark is the separate StatusIcon component dropped into the leading slot, the 'Covered' label or a Badge goes in the trailing one. Single-open groups (added 2026-10-21, Storybook's 'Single'): give every `<details>` in the group the same `name` attribute — the browser closes the others natively, still zero JS; without it any number can be open ('Multiple', the default). `.accordion--chevron-start` puts the chevron before the title (Storybook's default placement; ours stays at the end). Deferred: a nested/second-level variant.

gap.$description: Between the status icon, the title, the meta label and the chevron.

divider.$description: Hairline between rows; the last row's is dropped so it never doubles the wrapping Card's own edge — the same rule Table's row divider follows.

titleQuiet.$description: Optional title style for rows that live inside a group with its own heading — Explore Degrees' requirement lists, where a Card title names the group and every row under it is one requirement. Bold rows under a bold heading flatten the hierarchy: two levels set identically read as one level. The default stays heading-base, which is right for a standalone FAQ-style list where each row IS the heading of its own answer. Same size either way, so the row height does not change.

meta.$description: The trailing state label ('Covered', 'Still to do'). Quiet on purpose: the icon already carries the state, this just names it.

colorPrimary.$description: `.accordion--chevron-primary` — the chevron in the brand colour, for a list where the open/close affordance should be noticed (Storybook's 'Custom Chevron Style'). The default stays quiet.

slot.$description: A row has two optional slots around the title — leading (before it) and trailing (after it, before the chevron) — that hold whatever the consumer needs: a StatusIcon, a number, an Avatar before; a meta label, a Badge, a Counter after. Slots, not variants (2026-10-21): what sits there is content, not a kind of Accordion — Radix's AccordionTrigger takes children and has no status prop. Each slot is a flex row with the item gap.

gap.$description: Between things inside one slot (a number and a StatusIcon).

index.$description: Text style for a number in the leading slot ('1', '2') — ordered rows like restriction lines (Storybook's 'With Icon'). Same size as the title, quieter, tabular figures so 9 and 10 line up.

body.$description: The expanded region. It inherits the row's horizontal padding so its content lines up with the title above it, and adds bottom padding only — the summary's own padding already spaces the top.

bg.$description: The wash tier: a summary row rests on a white/transparent surface, so it takes fill.neutralHover (gray.100), not the Strong pair.
